title: Mailbox::new has 9 parameters with #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
description: Mailbox::new takes 9 positional arguments and suppresses the clippy warning with #[allow]. Since Mailbox is #[non_exhaustive], callers outside the crate cannot use struct literal syntax or functional record update, so the constructor is the only API. A builder pattern (MailboxBuilder) or a typed wrapper for the count/rights args would make call sites self-documenting. Alternatively, a MailboxCounts struct grouping the four u32 fields (total_emails, unread_emails, total_threads, unread_threads) would reduce it to 6 args without a full builder. Suppressing the lint without explanation is a pattern new contributors will copy.
